newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $855.3 mln for Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $855.3 mln for Tuesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for February 4 are expected to total $855.3 million in 23 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $119 million in 14 sales. The largest is a $25 million Forsyth County School District, Ga., at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $737 million in nine offerings. The largest is a $459 million Anaheim, Calif., revenue bond offering through PaineWebber Inc.
Day to day muni bond sales total $108 million in 4 offerings for February 4, which means dealers may bring the offerings to market if conditions warrant.
